meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,省下输入字数并留一份可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话都因记忆文件太长而挤占上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink memory files to a compact format to cut input tokens, keeping a backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long memory files keep eating your context window.

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单等自然语言文件压缩成穴居人式短句,减少输入 token;压缩版覆盖原文件,原文件另存为可读备份。只压散文,代码块、路径、命令等原样保留。
howto.when: 当你输入 `/caveman-compress <文件路径>`,或要求压缩某个记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、todo 列表)时接管;非自然语言文件如 .py、.json 不处理。

say.note: 压缩版覆盖原文件,备份存到独立数据目录

say.text: 帮我把这份 todo.md 压缩一下
say.note: 只压文字部分,代码与路径保持原样

howto.what_en: After install, Claude compresses natural-language files like CLAUDE.md or todo lists into terse caveman phrasing to cut input tokens. The compressed text overwrites the original; a readable backup is kept in a separate data dir. Only prose is compressed.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-compress <filepath>, or when you ask to compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list. Non-natural-language files like .py or .json are refused.

say_en.note: Overwrites file, backup goes to separate data dir
Only prose compressed; code and paths stay intact
Retries twice, then leaves original untouched
